main_point: The accepted revision resolves the initial uncited opening and NADPH/NADH source conflict. Seven final claims have complete selected-source support. One G3P claim remains partially supported because its only selected fragment does not cover the Calvin-stage attribution or G3P-to-carbohydrate relation.
method: Review each exact final factual claim against only its own actually returned supporting eid/fid union and immutable exact text. Do not backfill from available fragments, headings, complete_block flags, model reasons, or another claim's selected sources. Missing source wording is not proof of scientific falsehood.
